name: fluent
description: Fluent (Italian voice + frequency fork) — AI language tutor. Adds spoken practice (/fluent-speaking-voice: text-to-speech, speech recognition, pronunciation scoring) and frequency-first curriculum (learn the ~2,000 words that cover 80% of everyday Italian, in order). Built on spaced repetition (SM-2), active recall, adaptive difficulty. Start with /fluent-setup, then /fluent-learn, /fluent-vocab, /fluent-speaking-voice.
